name: Wyoming
summary_text: Two facility bills signed March 2025; birth-sex definition in statute. In the worst-law group per the July 2026 legal-risk assessment. Below the national score 0.36.

sources.claim_summary: NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (404 - MAP has retired/moved this equality-map entry); the underlying Movement Advancement Project equality-map page carried the authoritative per-state list of bans on transgender people using public bathrooms and facilities matching their gender identity, with the year each was enacted (the dossier's per-state facility-ban years come from it). For Wyoming it documents the facility bans signed in March 2025.

sources.title: Anti-Trans National Legal Risk Assessment Map: July 2026
sources.claim_summary: Erin In The Morning's July 2026 anti-trans legal-risk assessment map for transgender travellers (Erin Reed; republished 27 Aug 2026 by a regional LGBTQ outlet), built from 5 years of daily legislative tracking with a rubric for the worst bills. Wyoming is listed among 'the worst states' for legislation targeting transgender adults. Also documents that federal policies keep creating legal difficulties for transgender people nationwide.
